meaning_en: it replays past days: there is no control group, so it is not a promise that the change earns more
meaning_zh: 这是用过去的数据回放，没有对照组，不保证调整后会赚更多

meaning_en: this campaign's own days are too few to read its response: the pooled value of the others is used
meaning_zh: 这个 campaign 自己的数据不够看出反应，用了其他 campaign 的汇总值

meaning_en: its budget is the sum of its ad groups', not one set on the campaign
meaning_zh: 它的预算是各 ad group 预算的加总，不是设在 campaign 上

meaning_en: no budget change of this campaign has been seen yet, so how it responds is not measured
meaning_zh: 还没看过这个 campaign 调整预算后的结果，反应没有实际量过

meaning_en: stopped by the platform's minimum daily budget: the move is smaller than the rule wanted
meaning_zh: 被平台的最低日预算挡住：调整幅度比规则算的小

meaning_en: stopped by the platform's maximum daily budget: the move is smaller than the rule wanted
meaning_zh: 被平台的最高日预算挡住：调整幅度比规则算的小

meaning_en: {name}: change its daily budget from {frm} to {to} ({change:+.1%}); its marginal return reads {low} to {high}
meaning_zh: {name}：日预算由 {frm} 调到 {to}（{change:+.1%}）；边际回报区间 {low} 到 {high}

meaning_en: marginal return {value} (± {se}) against the common level {level}, z {z}, at most {cap:.0%} a day
meaning_zh: 边际回报 {value}（±{se}），所有 campaign 的共同水平 {level}，证据 z 值 {z}，每天最多调 {cap:.0%}

meaning_en: in the platform's ads manager set that campaign's daily budget to the proposed number (or, when its budget sits on its ad groups, scale them by the same share)
meaning_zh: 在平台的广告管理后台把这个 campaign 的日预算改成建议的数（预算设在 ad group 的，就按同一比例调整各个 ad group）

meaning_en: report it with the command below, then read the next pull: spend should follow the budget within a day or two
meaning_zh: 用下面的指令回报；下次拉取后看花费是否在一两天内跟着预算动

meaning_en: ask the maker for {n} creatives in {batches} batch(es) of up to {size}
meaning_zh: 向制作端要 {n} 条 creative，分 {batches} 批（每批最多 {size} 条）

meaning_en: exploration money of the window {money}, already committed {committed}, cost per verdict {unit_cost} ({basis}); batches {per}
meaning_zh: 窗口内探索预算 {money}，已被占用 {committed}，一条跑到结论约花 {unit_cost}（{basis}）；各批：{per}

meaning_en: ask the creative maker for the number, one new test group name for each batch, and build the ad group only when the handoff lists nothing as not exported
meaning_zh: 向制作端发需求（数量，每批用一个新的测试组名称），要等交付清单里没有未导出的项才建 ad group

meaning_en: record the request, so the next page counts it as in production and does not ask again
meaning_zh: 发出后记录这次需求，下一页会把它算进制作中，不会重复要

meaning_en: no creatives to ask for now
meaning_zh: 现在不用向制作端要 creative

meaning_en: no creatives to ask for: the exploration money is already taken by the creatives in testing and in production
meaning_zh: 现在不用再要 creative：探索预算已被测试中和制作中的 creative 占用

meaning_en: no creatives to ask for: the exploration money cannot carry another one to a verdict
meaning_zh: 现在不用再要 creative：探索预算撑不起再多一条跑到结论

meaning_en: no number of creatives yet: what it costs to reach a verdict is not known
meaning_zh: 还不能算要几条 creative：一条跑到结论要花多少还不知道

meaning_en: no creatives to ask for: the platform's budget range leaves no room for a new ad group
meaning_zh: 现在不用再要 creative：平台的预算范围容不下新的 ad group

meaning_en: exploration money of the window {money}, already committed {committed}, room for {capacity}
meaning_zh: 窗口内探索预算 {money}，已被占用 {committed}，还能再撑 {capacity} 条

meaning_en: earlier budget advice: {taken} taken, {not_taken} not taken, {open} still open
meaning_zh: 前几天的预算建议：{taken} 项已照做，{not_taken} 项没有，{open} 项还在等
